findings.comment: This checklist item applies to distribution facilities (primary, neutral, secondary conductors). Site has overhead electric transmission lines (≥60kV) per Electric Transmission Notes on Sheet 3. Transmission clearance requirements are governed by UCM § 1.14.0, not UCM § 1.10.3.

agentTrace.reasoning: The applicability gate requires determining facility type first.
